{{Top|leg}}
The '''G.O.''' was the name used by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] to describe the government office complex located in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]]. Along with the [[Corellian Assembly building]], the G.O. included bureau offices and the residence of the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]]. Arranged in a classical garden style, formal gardens were interspersed among the buildings, and the entire complex was surrounded by [[Keben Park]].

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] infiltrated the building and [[Assassination of Thrackan Sal-Solo|assassinated]] Head of State [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]].
